programme.desc: S05 E01 — Fixing a Cheap Flip With her daughter's dire health crisis alleviated, a mother is ready to part with a 1920s bungalow she bought to be by her side. She's looking to get top dollar, so she's calling on Lyndsay and Leslie go bold with an era-specific, glitzy upgrade.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Sell With a Kiss After helping friends settle into a new and larger family home, Lyndsay and Leslie take on their former place; the twins roll up their sleeves and look to make some updates in hopes of getting the most out of their old, well-lived-in townhouse.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Selling a Well-Loved Home Lyndsay and Leslie take over the reins to help a father part ways with his family home; it's a century-old house with features from multiple eras, so the twins look to make a cohesive and modern update in order to get top dollar.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E07 — A Doctor's Oasis Lyndsay and Leslie help a busy doctor increase the equity on her newly purchased condo and transform it into a serene oasis.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S08 E02 — Chasing Waterfalls A civil engineer and artist is moving from Seattle to Laurel, Miss., to be closer to his dad; he has a generous budget and an outdoor hot tub is a non-negotiable; Ben and Erin show him two large houses that suit his modern-contemporary vibe.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E15 — Ben vs. Bats After countless setbacks, an engaged couple's finally saved enough to renovate their first home together; the house needs more work than expected, and with bats in the attic and a tight budget, they call on Ben and Erin for help.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Steel Magnolia After finishing a 10-month reno on their forever home, a couple enlist Ben and Erin to help finish their backyard; they want to include a pool for their son, but they drop a late twist that could change everything.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E07 — The Wedding An engaged couple wants to update their midcentury home for their blended family as they start their next chapter; but an unexpected request and mounting complications ramp up the pressure, and Ben and Erin must race to finish before the wedding.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E08 — Little Brother on a Budget Ben's little brother and his wife secretly buy a fixer-upper and plan to renovate it themselves to save money; as they move and race to finish before their third baby arrives, Ben and Erin try to convince them to accept some help.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Welcome to the Haunted House Six designers tackle one of America's haunted houses while living in it; the scariest part isn't facing the spirits, but the four-day deadline to renovate two bedrooms, the risk of elimination and missing out on the chance to win $50,000.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S13 E02 — Ain't Nothin' But a Corn Dog A Bosnian couple has been living the American dream for over 20 years, and their luck continues after scratching up a $100,000 win; David helps the couple upgrade and search for a larger home in Grimes, Iowa.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E07 — BFF Lottery David brings along his bestie to help another pair of besties find a dream home for a daughter in Rochester, N.Y.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S14 E03 — The Wizard of Cape Coral David's back in Cape Coral, Fla., to find his newest winners a coastal dream home; since his last visit, Hurricane Ian left a path of destruction and limited housing; now, with some courage and heart, David makes dreams come true.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E07 — First-Time Homeowners, First-Time Millionaires! A young couple wins big and are ready to start building a life together and find a first home they can renovate; David arrives with plenty of ideas and helps explore options in the picturesque town of Rochester, N.Y.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S14 E01 — Luck Comes in Pairs A couple were thrilled when their son struck it big and won $100,000, and a year later, they won a whopping $2 million themselves; now, they're calling on David to help find a forever home where their lucky family can relax in Richmond, Virginia.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E08 — My Big Island Dream Home After receiving an inheritance, a couple looks to leave Oklahoma and find their dream home in Hawaii; they're searching for a place big enough to host family for holidays, and David makes a trip to the Big Island to help them find the perfect place.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S14 E04 — Pennies From Heaven After a tragedy, a couple feels as if the universe stepped in to deliver a gift in the form of a $10 million scratch-off; David is honored to help them search for beautiful properties in the military town of Jacksonville, N.C.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S15 E02 — Second Home Sanctuary A couple decides to sell their inherited farmland in Iowa and buy a cabin in Minnesota for family and friends to gather and celebrate holidays; for David, it's a chance to return to his childhood home to help them find a lakeside property.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S15 E01 — Nova Scotia Homecoming Queen With a lottery win in her pocket and a baby around the corner, a woman is ready to move back home to Shelburne, Nova Scotia; affordable oceanfront properties are on David's list, and he helps her find a cute home.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S03 E01 — The Wretched Road Trip Begins Retta's journey to find scary begins with a road trip where four homes compete for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a creepy concrete home, a haunted observatory and a home that's too haunted to live in.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Glamping Gone Wrong Leslie and Jasmine tackle an in-tents rental rescue in Silver Lake, California. A soaking wet floor and an unorthodox bathroom layout push Leslie's patience to the edge, and it needs all of Jasmine's creativity to save this failing retirement plan.
programme.title: Roast My Rental
